rule.question: how much forecasting accuracy survives a given reduction in inference cost?
rule.operating_point: per model x dataset x arm x budget eps: the SHALLOWEST block depth l < L whose VALIDATION MASE ratio to the full native model is <= 1 + eps at EVERY truncation depth j in [l, L-1] (sustained, the Phase-1 operator)
rule.fallback: no qualifying depth -> no truncation: the full native model (speedup 1)
rule.selection_data: validation only; the selected depth is frozen, then test is read once
rule.entrance_test: the frozen Phase-1 entrance test (H4_OUTCOME_RULE) is kept unchanged as the stricter secondary hypothesis test
